raw: {"found":true,"passages":["This Agreement shall become effective on the date of its execution and shall remain in force for three years (the \"Initial Term\"). Thereafter, the Agreement shall be automatically renewed for additional two year periods (each a \"Renewal Term\", the Initial Term and all Renewal Terms, the \"Term\") unless either Party notifies the other Party of its intention not to renew in writing at least three calendar months before the expiration of the then current Term."]}
